name: Asana
description: Asana helps teams organize projects, assign tasks, manage deadlines, and track work across multiple views.
best_for: Positioned for cross-functional teams operating at any scale, from small business to enterprise.
features: Work Graph connecting tasks, projects, and goals
Multiple project views for planning and tracking
AI Teammates that work inside existing workflows
Shared context between people and AI agents
Enterprise governance controls for AI agents
Work management, service management, and client management in one suite

alternatives.name: ClickUp
alternatives.description: A broad productivity platform combining project management, documents, dashboards, and automation.

alternatives.name: Monday.com
alternatives.description: A visual work-management platform with configurable boards and automated workflows.

alternatives.name: Trello
alternatives.description: A lightweight Kanban tool that organizes work with boards, lists, and cards.

alternatives.name: Zoho Projects
alternatives.description: An online project management platform for planning, tracking, and collaborating on work, with deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already using Zoho apps, and organizations wanting an affordable, feature-rich project tool

tiers.name: Personal
tiers.notes: Free forever for up to 2 users; unlimited tasks and projects with list, board, and calendar views.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: $10.99/user/month billed annually ($13.49 monthly); adds unlimited seats, Timeline/Gantt, reporting dashboards, automations, forms, and custom fields.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: $24.99/user/month billed annually ($30.49 monthly); adds portfolios, goals, workload, approvals, time tracking, and advanced integrations.
